text: You speak with a pistol, is you real? Nah, you hardly not. I make the party rock when I rock sipping on Bacardi shots. Pac and pun, Biggie and Big L. Slow your roll when I flow like you step inside a quicksand. Damn, I'm spazzing again. The beast is loose up in the booth. Send the track to a friend. Boogie. It's end to beginning, beginning to end.
